sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS e, "TV_Channel"."Package_Option" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "TV_series" JOIN "TV_Channel" ON "TV_Channel"."id" = "TV_series"."Channel"  GROUP BY "TV_series"."Channel", "TV_Channel"."Package_Option"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the g total of number of TV_series records (g level)
rank within the group by number of TV_series records: share of the g total, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS e, "TV_Channel"."Package_Option" AS g, AVG("TV_series"."Share") AS m1 FROM "TV_series" JOIN "TV_Channel" ON "TV_Channel"."id" = "TV_series"."Channel"  GROUP BY "TV_series"."Channel", "TV_Channel"."Package_Option"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of household audience share per TV_Channel within TV_Channel.Package_Option
gap to the g average of average of household audience share (g level)
rank within the group by average of household audience share, keep the top 3

why: average of household rating per TV_Channel within TV_Channel.Country
gap to the all average of average of household rating (all level)
rank within the group by average of household rating: gap to the all average, keep the top 3
